description: This file contains classes and functions for parsing and traversing HTML/XML trees using lxml, including custom tree walker and node wrapper classes.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root of an XML/HTML document, manages children including doctype and nodes.

classes.name: Doctype
classes.description: Represents the doctype declaration in an XML/HTML document.

classes.name: FragmentRoot
classes.description: Represents a fragment of nodes, inherits from Root.

classes.name: FragmentWrapper
classes.description: Wraps individual nodes within a fragment, providing additional methods.

classes.name: TreeWalker
classes.description: Custom tree walker class for traversing XML/HTML trees with filtering.

methods.name: ensure_str
methods.description: Converts input to a UTF-8 string if not already a text_type or None.

methods.name: __init__ (Root)
methods.description: Initializes Root object, processes doctype and children nodes.

methods.name: __init__ (Doctype)
methods.description: Initializes Doctype object with name, public_id, system_id.

methods.name: __init__ (FragmentRoot)
methods.description: Initializes FragmentRoot with a list of children.

methods.name: __init__ (FragmentWrapper)
methods.description: Wraps a node object, exposing text, tail, and attribute access.

methods.name: __init__ (TreeWalker)
methods.description: Initializes TreeWalker with a tree, sets up filtering.

methods.name: getNodeDetails
methods.description: Returns details about a node, including type and attributes.

methods.name: getFirstChild
methods.description: Returns the first child of a node, handling text nodes.

methods.name: getNextSibling
methods.description: Returns the next sibling of a node, handling text nodes.

methods.name: getParentNode
methods.description: Returns the parent node of a given node.
